title: Restriction of sheaf-module colimits to an open
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space and $\mathcal O_X$ a sheaf of commutative rings on $X$, and let $\Mod(\mathcal O_X)$ be the category of sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $U\subseteq X$ be open, $\mathcal O_U=\mathcal O_X|_U$ the sheaf of rings $W\mapsto\mathcal O_X(W)$ on the open subsets $W\subseteq U$, and for an $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal M$ let $\mathcal M|_U$ be the $\mathcal O_U$-module $W\mapsto\mathcal M(W)$ ($W\subseteq U$ open) with the restriction maps and module structures of $\mathcal M$ [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation]; for a morphism $\alpha$ of $\mathcal O_X$-modules let $\alpha|_U$ have the components $\alpha_W$, $W\subseteq U$. Let $I$ be a small category and $i\mapsto\mathcal M_i$ a diagram $I\to\Mod(\mathcal O_X)$ with a colimit $(\mathcal M,(c_i)_i)$ in $\Mod(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Then: (1) $(\mathcal M|_U,(c_i|_U)_i)$ is a colimit of the diagram $i\mapsto\mathcal M_i|_U$ in $\Mod(\mathcal O_U)$; (2) let $\mathcal P$ be the presheaf of $\mathcal O_U$-modules $W\mapsto\varinjlim_i\mathcal M_i(W)$ ($W\subseteq U$ open), with the restriction maps induced by those of the $\mathcal M_i$ and the coprojections $\iota_i:\mathcal M_i|_U\to\mathcal P$ [lem-weil-pbc-presheaf-modules-colimits-sectionwise], and let $\eta:\mathcal P\to\mathcal P^\#$ be its sheafification as a presheaf of $\mathcal O_U$-modules [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]; then the unique $\mathcal O_U$-linear $u:\mathcal P^\#\to\mathcal M|_U$ with $u\circ\eta\circ\iota_i=c_i|_U$ for all $i$ exists and is an isomorphism, i.e. the colimit of (1) is the sheafification of the sectionwise colimit of the restricted presheaves.

source.place: Modules, Lemma 01AH (modules-lemma-limits-colimits) (2) (colimits in Mod(O) are the sheafifications of the presheaf colimits; the module form of Sheaves, Section 009E (sheaves-section-limits-sheaves) (3)), and Modules, Lemma 01AJ (modules-lemma-exactness-pushforward-pullback) (2) with its proof (f^* commutes with all colimits as the left adjoint of f_*, Sheaves Lemma 0096), applied to the inclusion j:(U,O_U)->(X,O_X), for which j^* is the restriction (Sheaves, Lemma 00A0 (sheaves-lemma-j-pullback), Definition 00A1)

proof.text: Clause (1): Mathlib SheafOfModules.overPushforwardOverAdj gives the adjunction for overFunctor directly, without needing the additional sectionwise formulas of lem-weil-pbc-ringed-space-open-restriction-adjunction. source.place: Modules, Lemma 01AJ (modules-lemma-exactness-pushforward-pullback) (2) and its proof (adjoint pair, Sheaves Lemma 0096 (sheaves-lemma-adjoint-pullback-pushforward-modules)), for the open immersion j:(U,O_U)->(X,O_X) with j^* = restriction (Sheaves, Lemma 00A0 (sheaves-lemma-j-pullback), Definition 00A1 (sheaves-definition-restriction))

proof.text: *The sheafified sectionwise colimit is a colimit.* The site of open subsets of $U$ has sheafification of presheaves of abelian groups [def-weil-pbc-sheafification], and $\mathcal O_U$ is a sheaf of rings on it. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-colimits-forgetful] (2) to the diagram $i\mapsto\mathcal M_i|_U$ in $\Mod(\mathcal O_U)$ (its terms are $\mathcal O_U$-modules by Step 1): its colimit is the sheafification, as a presheaf of $\mathcal O_U$-modules [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification], of the sectionwise colimit $W\mapsto\varinjlim_i\mathcal M_i(W)$ with its evident coprojections. That sectionwise colimit, with its restriction maps and coprojections, is the presheaf $\mathcal P$ with the $\iota_i$ of the statement [lem-weil-pbc-presheaf-modules-colimits-sectionwise], and the evident coprojections of $\mathcal P^\#$ are the composites $\eta\circ\iota_i$. Hence $(\mathcal P^\#,(\eta\circ\iota_i)_i)$ is a colimit of $i\mapsto\mathcal M_i|_U$ in $\Mod(\mathcal O_U)$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit].

source.place: Modules, Lemma 01AH (modules-lemma-limits-colimits) (2), applied to the ringed space (U,O_U), and the paragraph before it ('To see this you use the universal property of sheafification'); Sheaves, Section 009E (sheaves-section-limits-sheaves) (3)

proof.text: Apply moduleSheaves_colimits_forgetful to the restricted diagram. It supplies a colimit cocone s, an isomorphism e from its vertex to the module sheafification of the sectionwise colimit, and the canonical coprojection equations after forgetting module structure. Let k be the unique isomorphism from s.pt to the restricted vertex given by the two colimit universal properties. Set u = e.inv followed by k.hom. This is an isomorphism. Applying the faithful presheaf forgetful functor and the formula for sheafificationHomEquiv, the supplied equations become the required equations for u after canceling e.hom followed by e.inv. Finally, any v satisfying them has the same image under sheafificationHomEquiv as u: use hom_ext for the sectionwise presheaf colimit. Injectivity of this equivalence gives v = u. The argument also covers empty indexing categories and the empty open, since it uses only universal properties.
